topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Found my old teddy at a yard sale today. It's a small world, I suppose. My first instinct was to buy it, to reclaim a piece of my past. But really, what’s the point? It’s just a bear, a symbol of a time long gone. I watched as someone else picked it up, examined it with a curious eye, and then placed it back, deciding it wasn’t worth the price. Just like that, it’s back on the shelf, unwanted. Just like everything else that fades into the background. I walked away, leaving it there among the forgotten trinkets. Who needs a reminder of what can’t be recaptured?
